experiments.scope: Selected target poseidon-orchard-r21-prefix-v1, organizer seeds, at most 1200 fresh canonical 64-byte message pairs per trial, deterministic from the supplied seed. Every eighth trial the program additionally runs one w=16 truncated first-repeat witness walk on the filed walk map (fresh (rho0, start) from the same trial seed, 4096-step cap) and reports its length and cap flag as untrusted participant observations; the runner executes the program twice and requires byte-identical output.
experiments.hypothesis: The submitted construction finds two distinct messages whose selected-round Orchard Poseidon digests agree on the low 14 bits within the per-trial budget.
